Class SLF4JRainbowGumEagerLoad

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.slf4j.SLF4JRainbowGumEagerLoad
All Implemented Interfaces:
RainbowGumServiceProvider, RainbowGumServiceProvider.RainbowGumEagerLoad
@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class) public final class SLF4JRainbowGumEagerLoad extends Object implements RainbowGumServiceProvider.RainbowGumEagerLoad
This is an internal detail to signal that this SLF4J implementation will load Rainbow Gum.
